error_reason: The Planner is the decisive error because it initiates a loop of retrying failed IMDb verification using the same mobile URL despite no progress. This rigid repetition causes the task to stall in the verification phase, preventing the agent from recognizing that Wikipedia (accessed in earlier steps) had already fully satisfied the task requirements (finding the 2017 film directed by Christopher B. Landon starring Jessica Rothe). If the Planner had stopped at Step 9 or 10, the task would have succeeded.
